retrieve_global_config: retrieve the global SynJaxConfig instance with all current settings
set_config_settings: set global SynJaxConfig settings by passing keyword arguments like checkpoint_loops or mtt_logdet_method
apply_temporary_config: apply temporary SynJaxConfig settings within a context manager that restores prior values on exit
configure_matrix_tree_theorem: configure Matrix-Tree Theorem settings including mtt_logdet_method and mtt_inv_method
configure_crf_algorithm: configure linear-chain CRF forward algorithm to use sequential or parallel mode
